description: Solar panel array / inverter string telemetry for predictive maintenance

fields.name: dc_voltage
fields.label: DC Voltage
fields.description: DC output voltage of the panel string

fields.name: dc_current
fields.label: DC Current
fields.description: DC output current of the panel string

fields.name: ambient_temperature
fields.label: Ambient Temperature
fields.description: Environmental air temperature at the site

fields.name: irradiance
fields.label: Solar Irradiance
fields.description: Global horizontal irradiance measured at the array

fields.name: soiling_index
fields.label: Soiling Index
fields.description: Estimated panel cleanliness ratio (1.0 = clean, 0.0 = fully soiled)

fields.name: inverter_efficiency
fields.label: Inverter Efficiency
fields.description: DC-to-AC conversion efficiency of the inverter

fields.name: power_residual
fields.label: Power Residual
fields.description: Actual AC power minus expected power from irradiance and temperature model

fields.name: temperature_delta
fields.label: Temperature Delta
fields.description: Module temperature minus ambient temperature — elevated values indicate hotspots

fault_types.name: soiling
fault_types.description: Gradual power output decline from dust/debris accumulation on panel surface

fault_types.name: hotspot
fault_types.description: Localized cell degradation causing temperature spike and power drop

fault_types.name: inverter_fault
fault_types.description: Sudden inverter failure causing power output to drop to near-zero
